aboutContent: I'm a full-stack developer who enjoys building clean, user-focused applications — whether it's crafting beautiful frontend interfaces with React, handling complex backend logic in Python, or wiring things up in the cloud with AWS.

Currently, I work at Tata Consultancy Services, mainly focused on backend development. I've handled everything from fixing tricky production issues to integrating services like EventBridge and Lambda with Salesforce. I'm someone who thrives on learning, problem-solving, and building things that make people's lives easier. Oh, and I recently cleared the AWS Developer Associate certification too!
When I'm not coding, you'll probably find me planning my next trip, volunteering at a hackathon, or binge-watching tech videos on YouTube. 😊
